name: The locket Jaina gave
summary: Jaina recognizes the locket she once gave Arthas. He kept it through the years of ruin and the fall of their kingdom. Tears come before words; then she holds to a small hope that some part of him might remember who he was before Frostmourne. Her words do not undo what he became. They name the distance between the young prince she loved and the Lich King she helped confront.
